### 6.3 `lightcraft` (`window.lightcraft`) — 595 Commands

- **Canvas ID:** `#lightcraft_canvas` (`#lightcraft_canvas_agent_cursor` overlay)
- **Control Dialect:** commands=`engine.commands`, execute=`engine.execute {command, params}`, docInspect=`ui.inspect`, uiInspect=`ui.inspect`, screenshot=`ui.screenshot`, pointer=`ui.pointer`

| Command ID (`command`) | Label / Title | Menu / Category | Shortcut | Parameters (`*` = required, `?` = optional) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `edit.undo` | Undo | Edit | `Cmd+Z` | — |
| `edit.redo` | Redo | Edit | `Cmd+Shift+Z` | — |
| `library.source` | Show Source | — | — | `{kind: all\\|recentlyAdded\\|album\\|recentlyDeleted\\|picks\\|missing\\|libraryFolder, id?: albumId, path?: a path from library.folders (for libraryFolder)}` |
| `library.filter` | Filter | — | — | `partial Filter: {text?, rating?, ratingOp?: atLeast\\|exactly\\|atMost, flag?: pick\\|reject\\|none\\|null, flags?: [pick\\|reject\\|none] (any of them; [] = no constraint), label?, kind?, merged?: hdr\\|panorama\\|hdrPanorama\\|any, edited?, date?, libraryFolder?: a path from library.folders, keyword?, person?, camera?}` |
| `library.folders` | Library Folders | — | — | `{} → [{name, path, count, own, volume, selectable, label?, children}] the disks and the folders the library's photos were imported from, with photo counts (subfolders included in `count`); show one with library.source {kind: libraryFolder, path} (rows with selectable false only open)` |
| `library.removeFolder` | Remove Folder from Library | — | — | `{path, disk?: bool} — move the library photos imported from this folder (and the folders inside it) to Recently Deleted; one undo step, no file is touched. A whole disk or share (`/Volumes/nas`, `C:\`, `\\srv\share`) goes only with `disk: true`, the startup disk never → {removed}` |
| `folder.label` | Set Folder Color Label | — | — | `{path, label: red\\|yellow\\|green\\|blue\\|purple\\|none} — give a folder of the library (one its photos were imported from, see library.folders) a colour label, or take it off (also once its photos are gone); one undo step. The label follows the folder when it is renamed or moved with folder.rename / folder.move → {path, label}` |
| `library.clearFilter` | Clear Filters | View | — | — |
| `library.toggleFilters` | Enable Filters | View | `Cmd+L` | `{} — with a filter set, puts it aside and shows everything; with one put aside, brings it back as it was (stars, flag, text… together). Setting or clearing a filter while it is off forgets the one put aside → {enabled, count}` |
| `library.sort` | Sort | View › Sort | — | `{key?: captureDate\\|importDate\\|editDate\\|fileName\\|rating\\|fileSize\\|random, ascending?: bool, group?: auto\\|none\\|day\\|month\\|year, seed?: u64 (the shuffle `random` gives)}` |
| `library.refresh` | Refresh View | View | — | `{} — show what matches now: a view that holds its photos (`library.holdView`) lets go of the ones that stopped matching a smart album's rules, Picks or the filter bar since it was opened, sorted or last refreshed` |
| `library.holdView` | Hold View Until Refreshed | View | — | `{on?: bool (toggles when omitted)} → {hold} — when on, an edit that makes a photo stop matching the view (a keyword given in a smart album of photos without keywords, a flag taken off in Picks, a rating under the filter bar's) keeps it in the view until `library.refresh`, Reshuffle, or another source, filter or sort; photos that start matching still appear at once, and deleting a photo or taking it out of the album or folder shown still takes it out of the view. Changing a smart album's rules is another view too. Off (the default): the view follows every edit. Kept with the library's preferences; asking for the state it already has changes nothing` |
| `library.shuffle` | Reshuffle | View › Sort | — | `{seed?: 0..2^53-1} — sort at random; without `seed` a new shuffle each time` |
| `library.groups` | Date Groups | — | — | `{by?: day\\|month\\|year (default: the sort's grouping; auto = day)} → [{key, label, start, count}] date headers of the grid` |
| `library.select` | Select Photos | — | — | `{ids: [id], active?: id, mode?: replace\\|add\\|toggle\\|range} — every id must be a photo of the library` |
| `library.selectAll` | Select All | Edit | `Cmd+A` | — |
| `library.devices` | Cameras and Cards | — | — | `{} → [{name, path (its DCIM folder), root}] — mounted volumes with a DCIM folder` |
| `photo.copyMetadata` | Copy Metadata | Photo | `Cmd+Alt+Shift+C` | `{} — title, caption, copyright (notice, status, usage terms, info URL), creator, location and keywords of the active photo` |
| `photo.pasteMetadata` | Paste Metadata | Photo | `Cmd+Alt+Shift+V` | `{ids?, fields?: [title\\|caption\\|copyright\\|copyrightStatus\\|usageTerms\\|copyrightUrl\\|creator\\|location\\|keywords] (default: all copied)}` |
| `library.selectBy` | Select by Flag, Rating or Label | — | — | `{flag?: pick\\|reject\\|none, rating?: 0..5, ratingOp?: gte\\|eq\\|lte (default gte), label?: red\\|…\\|none, add?: bool (extend the selection)} — among the photos in view` |
| `library.selectNone` | Deselect All | Edit | `Cmd+Shift+A` | — |
| `library.next` | Next Photo | — | `Right` | — |
| `library.previous` | Previous Photo | — | `Left` | — |
| `library.down` | Photo Below | — | `Down` | `{rows?: n (photos to move forward; default 1, the grid passes the distance to the cell below)}` |
| `library.up` | Photo Above | — | `Up` | `{rows?: n (photos to move back; default 1, the grid passes the distance to the cell above)}` |
| `photo.rate` | Set Rating | Photo › Set Rating | — | `{rating: 0..5, ids?, advance?: bool} — without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |
| `photo.decreaseRating` | Decrease Rating | — | — | `{ids?, advance?: bool} — without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |
| `photo.increaseRating` | Increase Rating | — | — | `{ids?, advance?: bool} — without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |
| `photo.flag` | Set Flag | Photo › Set Flag | — | `{flag: pick\\|reject\\|none, ids?, advance?: bool} — without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |
| `photo.cycleFlag` | Cycle Flag | Photo › Set Flag | ``` | `{ids?, advance?: bool} — each photo's own flag: unflagged -> pick -> reject -> unflagged; without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |
| `photo.increaseFlag` | Increase Flag Status | Photo › Set Flag | `Cmd+Up` | `{ids?, advance?: bool} — reject -> unflagged -> pick (stops at pick); without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |
| `photo.decreaseFlag` | Decrease Flag Status | Photo › Set Flag | `Cmd+Down` | `{ids?, advance?: bool} — pick -> unflagged -> reject (stops at reject); without `ids`, the selection moves on when this takes the active photo out of the view` |

| `slideshow.titles` | Slideshow Title Settings | — | — | `{intro?: screen, ending?: screen} where a screen is {enabled?: bool, color?: background "#rrggbb"\\|[r,g,b], content?: "none"\\|"identityPlate" (the Overlays identity plate, its text or image)\\|"text", text?: the text shown with content "text", overrideColor?: bool (draw the plate or text in textColor instead of the identity plate's colour; an image plate keeps its colours), textColor?: colour, scale?: height of the plate or text line as a fraction of the slide's shorter side (0.005–0.5; text wider than the slide shrinks to fit), duration?: seconds (0.5–120) \\| null (the slide duration)} — the intro plays once before the first slide, the ending after the last one when repeat is off; both fade with the playback fade; random order never moves them. Omitted keys keep their value, {} reads them; out-of-range numbers are clamped, wrong types refused; saved with the library → the settings and warnings (an unreadable identity plate image, a screen with nothing to show)` |

(a user template's file)}], previous: bool (the settings before the last apply can be restored with apply {id: "previous"}), folder: the user templates folder \\| null, problems: ["file: why it was skipped"]} — built-ins first, then user templates by name (files in <settings>/slideshow-templates, at most 1000)` |

| `denoise.clear` | Clear Denoise Cache | — | — | `{} → {deleted, bytes} — delete every cached denoised picture of this library (they are made again when wanted)` |
| `faces.models.list` | Face Models | — | — | `{} → {dir, enabled, embedder, runtime, models: [{id, name, role, licence{name, commercial, url, notice}, provenance, source, sizeBytes, known, installed, selected}]}` |
| `faces.models.inspect` | Inspect Face Model File | — | — | `{path} → what a .onnx file is: {kind: known \\| draft \\| unsupported, model, assumptions, reason, alreadyInstalled}; installs nothing` |
| `faces.models.install` | Install Face Model | — | — | `{path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true} → {installed, active: {embedder, enabled}} — copy a .onnx face recognition model into the models folder. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown its licence (see inspect) and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false the model becomes the one in use and recognition is switched on; an earlier model stays installed` |
| `faces.models.download` | Download Face Model | — | — | `{id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a recognition model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list), in the background over pure-Rust https (lightcraft-fetch). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, then installed, chosen and switched on by itself; `faces.models.downloads` shows how far it is` |
| `faces.models.downloads` | Face Model Downloads | — | — | `{} → {running, downloads: [{id, state: running \\| done \\| installed \\| failed \\| cancelled, bytes, total, error, from}]} — also installs any download that has arrived; `installed` stays listed until `faces.models.downloadCancel` clears it` |
| `faces.models.downloadCancel` | Cancel Face Model Download | — | — | `{id} → {discarded} — stop a download, or delete a finished one that was not installed` |
| `faces.models.test` | Test Face Model | — | — | `{id} → {ok, result: {loadMs, embedMs, dimension, checks}} — load an installed recognition model and check it gives sensible faces; needs the recognition runtime` |
| `faces.models.remove` | Remove Face Model | — | — | `{id} — delete an installed model` |
| `faces.models.select` | Choose Face Recognition Model | — | — | `{id: installed recogniser \\| null}` |
| `faces.enable` | Face Recognition On/Off | — | — | `{enabled?: bool} (toggles when omitted)` |
| `faces.detect` | Detect Faces | Photo | — | `{ids?, apply?: bool (default true), score?: 0.6, nmsIou?: 0.3, maxFaces?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{rect, score, landmarks}]}]}. Finds faces with the YuNet detector (download it first: `faces.models.download {id: "yunet-2023mar"}`) and, unless `apply` is false, adds them as unnamed face regions (one undo step), replacing earlier detections but never regions from XMP or ones you named; the sidecar is not touched` |
| `faces.gpu` | Face Models on the GPU | — | — | `{cpuOnly?: bool} → {cpuOnly, detection, recognition}: where the face models run, each as {checking, device, why} (null until it is loaded). The GPU is used only after a background check shows it gives the CPU's results faster; `cpuOnly: true` keeps every face model on the CPU (Settings ▸ Faces), `false` checks the GPU again` |
| `faces.index` | Index Faces | — | — | `{budgetMs?: 200, ids?: [photo ids to do first]} → {embedded, photosDone, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, ms} — embed the faces in the library with the chosen recognition model, as many photos as fit in the time (at least one); call again until `pendingPhotos` is 0. `budgetMs: 0` only reports` |
| `faces.suggest` | Suggest Names for Faces | — | — | `{ids?, threshold?, margin?, budgetMs?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{index, suggestion: {name, score, runnerUp} \\| null, candidates: [{name, score}]}]}]} — who the unnamed faces in these photos might be, from the faces already named in the library. Only suggestions: nothing is named` |
| `faces.pump` | Index Faces in the Background | — | — | `{pace?: pause \\| light \\| normal \\| full} → {active, inFlight, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, searchedPhotos, workers} — cheap to call every frame: takes in what the background workers have finished and gives them the next photos, as many at once as the pace allows (none when paused, one when light, half the machine's threads when normal, four fifths when full); inactive until face recognition is on in Settings with a model chosen` |
| `faces.evaluate` | Evaluate Face Recognition | — | — | `{budgetMs?: 0, burstSecs?: 5, margin?, thresholds?: [..], scope?: "visible"} → {queries, top1, sweep: [{threshold, suggested, correct, precision, recall}]} — leave-one-out over your named faces: each is ranked against the others (ignoring shots within burstSecs of it) to show how well the chosen model recognises people in *your* photos and which threshold to trust. Faces not yet embedded are done within budgetMs (`faces.index` does them all); counts only` |
| `faces.unnamed` | Unnamed Faces | — | — | `{limit?: 600} → {total, faces: [{photo, index, rect, view, suggestion: {name, score} \\| null}], ordered, ready} — the faces nobody has named; with recognition running, look-alikes are next to each other and a face the named ones recognise carries the name they suggest. `view` is the box to show the face by. Name them with `faces.nameFaces`` |
| `faces.nameFaces` | Name Faces | — | — | `{faces: [{photo, index}], name} → {named, photos} — name (or, with a null or empty name, clear) many face regions as one undoable step; the sidecar is not touched` |
| `faces.person` | Faces of a Person | — | — | `{name, more?: 120} → {name, total, confirmed: [{photo, index, rect}], more: [{photo, index, rect, score}], ready, pendingPhotos} — the faces named `name` across the library, and the unnamed faces that look most like them (best first, already embedded ones only, once recognition is on); confirm one with `faces.setName`` |
| `faces.setName` | Name Face | — | — | `{id?, index, name} — name a face region (null or empty clears it); undoable; the sidecar is not touched` |
| `faces.renamePerson` | Rename Person | — | — | `{from, to, merge?: bool} → {faces, photos, from, to, merged} — give every in-library face of `from` the name `to` (trimmed, any capitalization), one undo step; refused when `to` is already someone else unless `merge` is true, which combines the two; the sidecar is not touched` |
| `photo.readFocusPoints` | Read Focus Points | Photo | — | `{ids?, wait?: false} → {queued, running, last?: {total, done, found, none, unavailable, bytesRead, seconds, cancelled}} — read the camera's focus point for photos imported before it was read (Sony α1 and A7S III raws and JPEGs), from the few KB of each file that hold it, on a background job with a row in the activity stack. Without `ids`, every photo in the library not looked at yet; with `ids`, those photos, looked at again. Photos that have a point keep it. No undo step and no sidecar write. `wait: true` returns when all are read (scripts)` |
| `focus.pump` | Read Focus Points in the Background | — | — | `{pace?: pause \\| light \\| normal} → {active, running?: {done, total, found}, last?, lookedAt} — cheap to call every frame (the app does): takes in what the background focus-point reader has read and commits it in batches; reads nothing new while paused and rests between files when light. Starts the reader by itself once per library opening when photos are left to look at` |
| `activity.list` | Background Tasks | — | — | `{} → {tasks: [{id, kind, label, done, total, unit: count\\|bytes\\|percent, detail, cancellable, cancelling, ageMs}]} — the long-running tasks in flight (imports, exports, preview builds, downloads, the face scan…), oldest first; total 0 = not known yet` |
| `activity.cancel` | Cancel Background Task | — | — | `{id} \\| {all: true} → {cancelled: n} — ask a task (or every cancellable task) to stop; it stops at its next file or photo (a preview build also stops between a photo's own previews). An unknown id (it may have just finished) or a task that can't be cancelled is an error` |

| `collab.host` | Start live session | — | — | `{port? (default 47900, else any free port), bind?: "local" (this machine, default) \\| "lan" (the local network) \\| an IP address} → the open file's session: {session, link, url (invites: they carry the secret token), address, …}; sessions are per file, so other files' sessions go on (a session this file was in ends)` |
| `collab.share` | Share with a join code | — | — | `{via?: "online" (default: the open file is kept on the server in Preferences, `pref.publishServer`, and the server hands out the codes) \\| "local" (this app hosts it for people on the same network; no server), access?: "edit" (default) \\| "comment" (online only: view and comment, not edit) \\| "view" (look only: their edits are refused): which code `code` is, server? (online: another server's address, with ?key=… when it needs its key), key? (online: the server's key, when the address has none), name? (online: the file's name there), port?, bind?: "lan" (default) \\| "local" (this machine only) \\| an IP address (local)} → the open file's session as `collab.peers` gives it: `code` is what others type to join (`collab.join {code}`, the Join field), `link` the invite link to give with it and `url` its WebSocket URL (local: the ones that go with `code`, so a view-only code's link and URL let people look only; online: your own link to the file, which edits: `share` has the link that goes with each code). Local: at once, the code carries the host's IPv4 address, port and secret (K7M2Q-…, 20 symbols), and `share` is {via, access, shared, editCode, viewCode, editLink, viewLink}: the edit and view-only ways in, each with its own secret (commentCode and commentLink null). Online: status "connecting" first; once live `code` is the server's (K7M-2QX-9TD) and `share` is {via, access, shared, editCode, viewCode, commentCode, editLink, viewLink, commentLink}: links made for others (commentCode and commentLink null from a server older than comment links) (the file's own links in `published` stay yours); `code` stays null when the server is older than join codes (give `share.editLink` / `share.viewLink` instead). Called again while shared: only switches which code `code` is (`access`). Called after `collab.stop` on a file that is still on the server: new links and codes for that same file (nothing is published twice). `collab.stop` stops sharing` |
| `collab.stop` | Stop live session | — | — | `{} → {ended}: the open file's session ends (a session this app hosts stops for everyone; a joined one is left). A file shared online with `collab.share` is different: its sharing stops → {ended: false, shared: false}: the links and codes others got are revoked on the server, whoever joined with them is disconnected at once (they keep their copy), and you stay in the file, which stays on the server, open only to you (`collab.share` shares it again with new codes; `collab.leave` leaves it there; `collab.manageFile {action: "remove"}` with its owner token takes it off the server)` |
| `collab.join` | Join live session | File | — | `{code \\| link (a join code: K7M-2QX-9TD from a server, asked at the server in Preferences; a longer one for the local network; spaces, dashes and case don't matter, O reads as 0 and I or L as 1; or an invite link: figcraft://join?host=…&file=…&token=…, figcraft://join?server=ws(s)://…&file=…&token=… or ws(s)://host:port/?file=…&token=…, from a session an app hosts or a server's share link; either key takes either)} → the new session: {session, status: "connecting", …}; its file opens in a tab of its own (other files' sessions go on) and `collab.peers` tells when it's live (`sessions` lists it until then, and if it fails)` |
| `collab.reconnect` | Reconnect live session | — | — | `{} → {status}: for the open file's session when it is disconnected: a reconnect that is waiting tries now, and a session that couldn't go on (`failed`, the file open in its tab) is joined again there, what you changed since going on top (your whole version opening beside it when some of it can't). Refused when nothing was lost` |
| `collab.leave` | Leave live session | — | — | `{session? (a session's id from `collab.peers`'s `sessions`, e.g. a join still on its way; default: the open file's session)} → {ended}: the synced file stays open as a local copy (also how a tab stops showing a session that couldn't go on)` |
| `collab.publish` | Publish to server | File | — | `{server: ws://host:port/?key=… or wss://host/path/?key=… (the server's address with its key; `figcraft-server key` prints it; without a key on a server open to the public), key? (when the address has none), name? (default: the file's name)} → status "connecting": the open file is uploaded as a new file and this tab syncs through the server; `collab.peers` then has `published: {server, file, name, edit, view, owner (published without a key: the owner token, shown once), expires (seconds since 1970, or null)}` and `hosting` (the server's operator, terms and idle expiry)` |
| `collab.serverInfo` | Server info | — | — | `{server: ws://host:port/ or wss://host/path/} → {open (anyone may publish without the key), operator, terms (a web address), idleDays (files published without the key are deleted after this many days unopened; null: kept), maxFileMb, expires}` |
| `collab.manageFile` | Manage published file | — | — | `{file (its id), server?, owner? (the server's address and the owner token you got when you published the file without the key; each defaults to what is recorded for one of your online files, see `collab.files`), action: links \\| createLink \\| revoke \\| share (others get new links and join codes) \\| unshare (the links and codes others got are revoked; the file stays yours on the server) \\| rename \\| remove (the file is deleted from the server and leaves your online files), access? (createLink: view (default) \\| comment \\| edit), label? (createLink), link? (revoke: a link's id), name? (rename)} → {links: [{id, access, label, created}]} \\| {id, access, link (a new share link, shown once)} \\| {shared, code, viewCode, commentCode, editLink, viewLink, commentLink} \\| {done}` |
| `collab.report` | Report file to server operator | — | — | `{reason (a few words, at most 500 characters)} → {sent}: the file you joined on a server is reported to its operator; the session's message says when the server kept it (servers older than this app don't take reports)` |
| `collab.peers` | People in this file | — | — | `{} → the open file's session (each open file has its own or none): {available, canHost (false in the browser: it can only join), session (its id; null: this file isn't in a session), status: off\\|connecting\\|live\\|reconnecting\\|failed, reason?, role, me, name, color, fileName, pages, link, url, address, network, access: edit\\|view\\|comment (view: a view link or code, a server's or a local network share's, edits are refused; comment: a server's comment link, edits other than to comment threads are refused), readOnly (the open file can't be edited now: view only, comment only, or being published), published (a file you published: {server, file, name, edit, view}), code (the join code to give others, when the file was shared with `collab.share`; null otherwise or while it is on its way), share ({via: online\\|local, access, shared (false: a file of yours on a server that nobody else gets into now), editCode, viewCode, commentCode, editLink, viewLink, commentLink (what others join with; null when not shared)} or null), follow, syncing, document (index of the synced open document), editing (the text layer you type in: {node, layer, caret, selection}), peers: [{id, name, color, editing (theirs, same shape, or null), presence: {cursor: [page, x, y], selection, viewport: [page, x, y, w, h], editing_text}}], sessions: [{session, document (index of its open document; null for a join on its way), status, reason, role, fileName, link, peers (how many others)}] (every session of the app)}` |
| `collab.follow` | Follow | — | — | `{client? (a peer's id; omit to stop following)} → {follow}` |
| `collab.removePerson` | Remove from session | — | — | `{client (a peer's id)} → {removed, name}: they are disconnected (they keep their copy) and can't join again from their address while the session runs; only the person hosting, or the owner of a file on a server, can do it` |
| `collab.cursor` | Show cursor at | — | — | `{x?, y? (page coordinates on the current page; omit both to hide)} → {cursor} (agents; in the app the pointer drives it): your pointer in the open file's session (null when the file isn't in one)` |
| `collab.cursorChat` | Cursor chat | — | `/` | `{text? (shown next to your cursor for everyone, at most 100 characters; empty closes it; omit to open the chat box in the app)} → {chat} (or {open}); others see it fade after 5 s without changes` |
| `collab.spotlight` | Spotlight me | — | — | `{on? (default: toggle)} → {spotlighting}: everyone in the session follows your view and page until they move theirs` |
| `collab.files` | Your online files | — | — | `{refresh? (true: ask each server once what became of its files, and the server in Preferences for its team list; default false: no network)} → {files: [{server, host, file (its id), name, created, opened (seconds since 1970), shared (others get in with a code now), code, viewCode, commentCode (the join codes, while shared; commentCode null from a server older than comment links), state: unknown \\| online \\| gone (the server no longer has it: removed or expired), expires, session, document (the session and open document it is in now, or null), hasOwnerToken: true}], problems: [{server, host, state: offline \\| unsupported (a server older than this request), reason}], max, team: {server, host, state: listed \\| none (the server keeps no team list) \\| offline, reason, web (where its browser build is, or null), files: [{file, name, updated, people, access, link (figcraft://join?server=…&file=…&team=1: joins it, no secret in it), webLink (the same in the browser build, or null)}]} or null (not asked yet)}: the files you published or shared without a server key, most recently opened first, as recorded on this computer with the preferences, and the files shared now on the server in Preferences when its operator keeps a team list (everyone who reaches it may open them; `collab.join {link}` does). Owner tokens and your own links are never in the result` |
| `collab.openFile` | Open online file | — | — | `{file (its id, from `collab.files`), server? (when files on several servers have that id)} → {session, status: "connecting", document, alreadyOpen, file, server, name}: joins the file as its owner in a tab of its own (`collab.peers` tells when it's live; `collab.share` and `collab.stop` there start and stop its sharing); a file that is open already comes to the front instead (alreadyOpen: true)` |
| `collab.forgetFile` | Forget online file | — | — | `{file, server?} → {forgotten, file, server, onServer}: drops the file from the list on this computer only. The file stays on its server until it expires, and without its owner token it can't be managed from here again (`collab.manageFile {action: "remove"}` takes it off the server instead)` |
| `collab.recoverFile` | Recover online file | — | — | `{path (a recovery copy of one of your online files), file, server?, session, client, seq, secret? (who the app was in the file when the copy was written, and the server's last change it had: from the note beside the copy)} → {session, status: "connecting"}: joins the file again as its owner and keeps the copy until the file arrives. Then: the server has everything in the copy → nothing more; the copy has changes of yours the server never confirmed and nothing else changed there → they are applied on top as one edit ("Recovered changes", synced to everyone); anything else changed meanwhile → the copy opens beside the file as “<name> (recovered copy)”; the file can't be joined → the copy opens as an unsaved document. The session's message says which` |
| `collab.registerLinks` | Open invite links in FigCraft | — | — | `{on? (default: switch)} → {on, registered}: make this app the opener of figcraft:// invite links (or stop); also the Preferences checkbox` |

| `file.newFromTemplate` | New from template | File | — | `{template (an id from `template.list`), name? (the document's name; default the template's)}  opens a new, unsaved document built from the template → {index, template}; without `template`, returns {templates} (and the app shows them to pick from)` |
| `data.fill` | Fill copies with data | — | — | `{id (the frame to repeat), rows: [{<layer name>: text \\| {text?, fill? (#rrggbb), visible?, fit? (true or text.fit's {maxLines?, minSize?, orphans?}: size the text to its box)}, name? (the copy's name)}] (every layer with that name in the copy; up to 500 rows), gap? (between copies, placed in a row to the right; default 100), formats? ([{name?, width, height}]: each row once per size, the copy resized so its auto layout reflows and named <name>-<format name>; e.g. feed 1080×1350, story 1080×1920, square 1080×1080), dir? (export each copy there as <name>.<format>), format? (png\\|jpg\\|webp\\|svg\\|pdf; default png), scale? (default 1)}  one undo step  → {ids (the copies, in row order), missing (keys no layer is named), files? (paths written, one per copy: same file names get a numbered suffix), errors? ([{id, path, error}] for exports that failed; the copies stay)}` |
| `text.fit` | Fit text to its box | — | — | `{ids? (text layers; default the selection), maxLines? (default: no limit but the box height), minSize? (smallest font size, px; default 60% of the current), orphans? (avoid a one-word last line; default true)}  needs a fixed width (fixed or auto-height text)  → {fitted: [{id, fontSize, lines, fits, orphan}]}` |
| `board.sticky` | Sticky note | — | — | `{x, y (its top-left, in the parent), text?, color? (yellow\\|orange\\|red\\|pink\\|violet\\|blue\\|green\\|gray or hex; default the sticky tool's), author? (a name, or false for none; default yours), parent?} → {id, text}` |
| `board.nextSticky` | Next sticky note | — | `Shift+Cmd+Enter` | `{id? (a sticky or shape; default the selected or edited one), side?: right\\|below\\|left\\|above (default right), edit? (start typing in it; default false)} → {id, text, connector?}  a sticky of the same colour beside a sticky; after a shape, the next shape joined to it by a connector, as board.addConnected` |
| `board.addConnected` | Add connected shape | — | — | `{id? (a sticky or shape; default the selected or edited one), side?: right\\|below\\|left\\|above (default right), at? ([x, y] on the page: the next one's centre, anywhere, instead of its place on that side; the connector then leaves by `side` and arrives by the side facing it), edit? (start typing in it; default false)} → {id, text, connector}  the next one of the same kind, size and colour on that side, joined by a connector` |
| `board.shape` | Shape with text | — | — | `{shape: rectangle\\|roundedRectangle\\|ellipse\\|diamond\\|triangle\\|triangleDown\\|parallelogramRight\\|parallelogramLeft\\|trapezoid\\|pentagon\\|hexagon\\|octagon\\|star\\|plus\\|arrowLeft\\|arrowRight\\|chevron\\|speechBubble\\|database\\|document\\|predefinedProcess\\|manualInput\\|internalStorage, x, y, width?, height? (default 160), text?, color?, parent?} → {id, text}` |
| `board.connector` | Connector | — | — | `{from, to (each a layer id or {x, y} on the page), fromSide?, toSide? (auto\\|top\\|right\\|bottom\\|left), fromAt?, toAt? ([x, y] on the layer, fractions of its box), style?: straight\\|elbow\\|curved, startCap?, endCap? (none\\|lineArrow\\|triangleArrow\\|circleFilled\\|diamondFilled…; default an arrow at the end), label?} → {id, label?}  a line that follows the layers it joins` |
| `board.reattach` | Reattach connector | — | — | `{id? (a connector; default the selection), end: from\\|to, target (a layer id, or {x, y} on the page to leave the end free), side? (auto\\|top\\|right\\|bottom\\|left), at? ([x, y] on the layer, fractions of its box)} → {id}  moves one end of a connector` |
| `board.reshape` | Reshape connector | — | — | `{id? (a connector; default the selection), portion (0 is the first run of an elbow, or a curve's middle), x, y (where it moves to on the page; a first or last run gets an extra run to stay on its end)} → {id}` |

### 6.9 `texturecraft` (`window.texturecraft`) — 173 Commands

- **Canvas ID:** `#texturecraft_canvas` (`#texturecraft_canvas_agent_cursor` overlay)
- **Control Dialect:** commands=`command.list`, execute=`command.run {id, params}`, docInspect=`session.inspect`, uiInspect=`ui.inspect`, screenshot=`ui.screenshot`, pointer=`ui.input`

| Command ID (`command`) | Label / Title | Menu / Category | Shortcut | Parameters (`*` = required, `?` = optional) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `edit.undo` | Undo | Edit | `Ctrl+Z` | `{steps?: 1 (as many as there are)} → {undone: the last step undone, steps}` |
| `edit.redo` | Redo | Edit | `Ctrl+Y` | `{steps?: 1 (as many as there are)} → {redone: the last step redone, steps}` |
| `edit.history` | History | — | — | `{} → {undo: steps, oldest first, redo: undone steps, next first}` |
| `layer.add.paint` | Add paint layer | Layers | — | `{name?}` |

| `layer.add.group` | Add folder | Layers | — | `{name?}` |

| `layer.fill.projection` | Set fill projection | — | — | `{layer? \\| effect?: content fill effect id, projection?: uv\\|triplanar\\|planar\\|spherical\\|cylindrical (default: the current one), scale?: number \\| [u, v] (uv), rotation?: degrees (uv), offset?: [u, v] (uv) \\| [x, y, z] (triplanar, planar), sharpness?: 1..64 (triplanar), axis?: 0\\|1\\|2 (planar, cylindrical)} — what is not given keeps its value` |

### 6.10 `materialcraft` (`window.materialcraft`) — 93 Commands

- **Canvas ID:** `#materialcraft_canvas` (`#materialcraft_canvas_agent_cursor` overlay)
- **Control Dialect:** commands=`command.list`, execute=`command.run {id, params}`, docInspect=`session.inspect`, uiInspect=`ui.inspect`, screenshot=`ui.screenshot`, pointer=`ui.input`

| Command ID (`command`) | Label / Title | Menu / Category | Shortcut | Parameters (`*` = required, `?` = optional) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file.new` | Graph... | File › New | `Ctrl+N` | `{name?, kind? (material\\|function), template? (see graph.templates), size? (px, power of two)} adds a new graph to the package and opens it` |
| `file.newPackage` | Empty package | File › New | — | `{name?} opens a new package alongside the existing packages` |
| `file.open` | Open... | File | `Ctrl+O` | `{path} opens an SBS package; returns `warnings` and `path` (null when unsupported content requires Save As)` |
| `file.save` | Save | File | `Ctrl+S` | `{path?} saves native SBS to the current file or `path`` |
| `file.saveAs` | Save as... | File | `Ctrl+Shift+S` | `{path} saves the package under a new name` |
| `file.export` | Export outputs... | File | `Ctrl+Shift+E` | `{dir, format? (png\\|jpg\\|tga\\|tif\\|bmp\\|webp\\|exr\\|hdr), pattern? ($(graph)_$(identifier)), depth? (8\\|16\\|32), size? (px of the larger side, rounded down to a power of two, 16..8192; default the graph's size, keeping its proportions), graph?} cooks the graph at full size and writes every output` |
| `file.importBitmap` | Import bitmap... | File | — | `{path, name?} embeds an image file as a resource; returns its name` |
| `graph.templates` | Graph templates | — | — | `{} lists the templates for file.new` |
| `package.activate` | Open package | — | — | `{document} activates an open package without losing edits or history` |
| `package.close` | Close package | — | — | `{document?, discard?: bool} closes a package; modified packages require explicit discard` |
| `package.closeAll` | Close all packages | — | — | `{discard?: bool} closes all packages; modified packages require explicit discard` |
| `graph.instance.reference` | Open graph reference | — | — | `{id, function?: FunctionGraphTarget} resolves the source package and graph without changing the document` |
| `graph.instance.add` | Add graph instance | — | — | `{document, graph, function?: FunctionGraphTarget, at? [x,y]} instances a compatible graph from an open SBS package; requires an output and rejects cycles` |
| `graph.node.info` | Copy node info | — | — | `{id} returns text describing a node without changing the document or node clipboard` |
| `file.newAtomicSample` | Atomic sample | File › New | — | `{} opens an original graph made only of native primitives` |
| `file.exportMaterial` | Export material... | File | — | `{path, graph?, size? (px, power of two), values? {input: value}, inputs? {identifier: image path}} cooks the graph and writes a portable .mcmat material (maps, exposed inputs, source package) for TextureCraft` |

| `edit.redo` | Redo | Edit | `Ctrl+Y` | — |

### 6.12 `soundcraft` (`window.soundcraft`) — 553 Commands

- **Canvas ID:** `#soundcraft_canvas` (`#soundcraft_canvas_agent_cursor` overlay)
- **Control Dialect:** commands=`engine.commands`, execute=`engine.execute {command, params}`, docInspect=`session.inspect`, uiInspect=`ui.inspect`, screenshot=`ui.screenshot`, pointer=`ui.click`

- **Canvas ID:** `#deckcraft_canvas` (`#deckcraft_canvas_agent_cursor` overlay)
- **Control Dialect:** commands=`engine.commands`, execute=`engine.execute {command, params}`, docInspect=`document.inspect`, uiInspect=`ui.inspect`, screenshot=`ui.screenshot`, pointer=`ui.pointer`

| `file.save` | Save | File | `Cmd+S` | `{path?, format?: deckcraft\\|pptx}` |

### 6.15 `gridcraft` (`window.gridcraft`) — 403 Commands

- **Canvas ID:** `#gridcraft_canvas` (`#gridcraft_canvas_agent_cursor` overlay)
- **Control Dialect:** commands=`engine.commands`, execute=`engine.execute {command, params}`, docInspect=`document.inspect`, uiInspect=`ui.inspect`, screenshot=`ui.screenshot`, pointer=`ui.pointer`

| Command ID (`command`) | Label / Title | Menu / Category | Shortcut | Parameters (`*` = required, `?` = optional) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file.new` | New Workbook | File | `Cmd+N` | `{sample?: "budget"\\|"sales"\\|"grades"}` |
| `file.open` | Open… | File | `Cmd+O` | `{path} \\| {name, base64}, plus {password} for a password-protected workbook and {csvAsText?: bool} to keep every csv/tsv/txt field as text, with no number or date conversion (xlsx, xlsm, xls import, xlsb and ods data import, csv, tsv, txt, json)` |
| `file.save` | Save | File | `Cmd+S` | `{path?} (xlsx by default; .csv/.tsv/.json/.html/.pdf by extension)` |
| `file.saveAs` | Save As… | File | `Cmd+Shift+S` | `{path} (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv, .json, .html, or .pdf: a PDF of the active sheet)` |
| `file.saveBytes` | Encode Workbook | — | — | `{format?: xlsx\\|csv\\|tsv\\|json\\|html} → {base64}` |
| `file.close` | Close | File | `Cmd+W` | `{force?: bool, document?: bool} (closes the active window, or with `document` the workbook and all its windows; the workbook closes with its last window)` |

| `window.activate` | Switch Window | Window | — | `{window} \\| {doc} \\| {index} (a window id, a workbook id, or the workbook's position in the list)` |
